rules: Use BetFlag/AAMS direct as the operational quote source whenever a fresh verified quote is available.
Do not block analysis waiting for GoldBet when BetFlag/AAMS is available.
Do not classify a missing BetFlag/AAMS market as not quoted without market-discovery evidence.
Treat GoldBet acquisition failure as diagnostic only unless GoldBet was explicitly requested by the user.
Alternative operational sources must be labelled explicitly and never silently relabelled.
